crossRefs.note: “Go inquire of Yahweh for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that…
She said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, you shall tell him this, ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says: “About the words which you have heard,
translations.bsb: But as for the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘As for the words that you heard,
translations.kjv: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;
translations.asv: But unto the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Jehovah, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith Jehovah, the God of Israel: As touching the words which thou hast heard,
